long_biography.plain_text:
Formula One champion Nico Rosberg used meditation and repeated kart testing to sharpen his concentration and driving technique. He also removed distractions during his title campaign, cutting out news, email and Instagram to focus on preparation. His attention to engineering had already impressed Williams, where he achieved the team's highest score in its aptitude test before joining the driver line-up.

As an investor, Rosberg seeks business introductions as well as financial returns. He approaches founders directly and brings entrepreneurs together at Grand Prix events. He has helped broker commercial agreements between startups and German companies whose owners invest in Rosberg Ventures.
